Yes, that is correct. Memorial Union CyBowl & Billiards is significantly more affordable than Perfect Games, particularly for individual games and student rates.

Memorial Union CyBowl & Billiards

This is the budget-friendly choice, especially with university-specific deals.

  • Per Game Pricing: Rates are approximately $2.50–$3.00 for students and $3.00–$3.50 for the public.
  • Buck Bowling: On Sundays and Mondays (noon to close), those with a university ID can get games, shoe rentals, and sodas for $1.00 each.
  • Amenities: This is a smaller 8-lane facility with billiards, table tennis, and board games.

Perfect Games

This is a larger entertainment complex where pricing is primarily based on hourly lane rentals.

  • Hourly Lane Rates: Rentals typically cost $45 per hour from Sunday to Thursday and increase to $55 per hour on Fridays and Saturdays.
  • Shoes: Rentals are around $4.00 per person.
  • Entertainment: The higher price point covers a much larger facility that includes a two-story laser tag arena, a massive arcade, and a full-service sports bar and restaurant.
